meta.name: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
meta.description:
In this thrilling final series starring Jeremy Brett as the famous 'consulting detective' Sherlock Holmes, six of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's short stories are adapted: The Three Gables, The Dying Detective, The Golden Pince-Nez, The Red Circle, The Mazarin Stone, and The Cardboard Box.

Rated PG · Ended · First aired 7 Mar 1994 · United Kingdom · Language: English
Studio: Granada Television · Network: ITV1

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: The Three Gables
videos.overview: After her grandson's death, an old woman consults Holmes, after refusing a strange offer to buy her house including all its contents.

videos.title: The Dying Detective
videos.overview: When Victor Savage begins using opium and behaving strangely, his wife consults Holmes. Victor dies, and Holmes suspects his cousin, knowledgeable in rare diseases.

videos.title: The Golden Pince-Nez
videos.overview: Holmes and Mycroft investigate the murder of a professor's assistant who died clutching a woman's pince-nez.

videos.title: The Red Circle
videos.overview: Mrs. Hudson asks Holmes to help her friend with a lodger who insists on nobody entering his room, and his secret past is uncovered.

videos.title: The Mazarin Stone
videos.overview: Mycroft investigates when the Mazarin Stone is stolen from a museum, and Watson deals with the promise of a large inheritance if a third person with the surname of Garrideb can be found.

videos.title: The Cardboard Box
videos.overview: When Susan Cushing is sent two severed ears, Holmes connects the case with her missing sister.
